coverage: Whole group · one reported precision manufacturing segment
definition: Group profit after costs and tax, including the share of profit belonging to minority shareholders in subsidiaries.
location: Annual report, consolidated statement of profit and loss (PDF page 191, printed page 189), consolidated notes 21 and 31.
notes: The group reported ₹475.15 crore of product sales and ₹119.36 crore of service sales, with the rest of operating revenue from scrap sales and export incentives. Of group profit after tax, ₹132.88 crore belonged to owners of the company and ₹0.69 crore to minority holders, rounded separately.
insight: Group sales and profit grew, but other income also rose. Read operating revenue, other income and profit together before attributing the entire increase to more component sales.
